source_message:
fix+feat: verification pipeline — PEP/EDD bug fix + training CI + adversarial sim

- compliance_validator: add 'without EDD', 'PEP without', 'approve PEP without' to forbidden patterns
  (FCA MLR 2017 §4 — EDD mandatory for PEPs; was incorrectly returning CONFIRMED)
- training-quality-report.yml: GitHub Actions for deepeval metrics + evidently drift
  (triggers on corpus push or weekly Monday 03:00 UTC)
- run-adversarial-sim.sh: GMKtec cron script for LLM-based adversarial simulation
  (needs Ollama qwen3-banxe-v2; saves results to docs/adversarial-results/)
